authority: User-defined Foster plant -> indexed35HzVIT -> rolling estimator -> evidence compressor -> rolling estimator feedback

prohibited_compressor_inputs: successive point estimates treated as independent observations

model_binding.coordinate_semantics: Continuous declared charts; no three-level capacity restriction. C_i=tau_i/R_i is derived. Preserve branch pairing and enforce0<tau1<tau2<tau3 across the admitted domain; never sort state values independently.
model_binding.temperature: Exogenous cell temperature initially; parameter-specific reciprocal-kelvin Arrhenius law IDs, reference temperature and units belong to producer model. Shared uncertain thermal coefficients remain joint variables or explicitly characterized inputs.
model_binding.OCV: Initial U(z,T)=a(T)+b(T)*z+r(z,T), b(T)>0 on admitted domain. r=0 is an explicit linear reference; a small residual requires a declared bound/model. No uncharacterized residual may be silently recast as independent sensor noise.
model_binding.OCV_identifiability: With unknowna,b,z0,Q at fixedT, voltage constrains a+b*z0 and b/Q. AbsoluteQ requires independent OCV/SOC calibration or equivalent informative anchors. Shared calibration uncertainty is retained once, not relearned independently each window.
model_binding.health: Reference-parameter trajectories inferred from rolling evidence. No compressor-owned nonzero drift, discount or process-noise injection. Stationary-reference mode is explicit; changing-health mode requires producer-declared trajectory variables, continuity and uncertainty, without a hidden deterioration rate.
model_binding.charge: Integrator tracks transferred charge; Q is estimated capacity. Changes in Q, C or temperature require an explicit charge/availability and RC-state convention in the producer model. A fittedQ revision is not itself a physical charge-loss event.
model_binding.hysteresis: User normalized throughputdxi=abs(I)*dt/(3600*Q) with dimensionlessgamma+/gamma- and terminal+H*h. Distinct identity from oldperAh rates/minusHh convention. Preserve jointQ/gamma/H/SOC dependence.

EstimateView.purpose: User/reporting output only; never appendable as evidence

EvidenceToken.owns: Only newly retired observations and their chronological transport, interval[a,b)
EvidenceToken.payload: Joint boundary kernel or an explicitly qualified approximation. Retain cross terms, shared nuisance, deterministic constraints and normalization; point/curvature summaries are not presumed sufficient.
EvidenceToken.producer: Build from owned physical likelihood/transport factors. Earlier feedback may select a linearization chart but its density, prior, information matrix and outside-window observations must not enter the token as evidence. Do not obtain the token by naively subtracting approximate posterior/prior Hessians.
EvidenceToken.anchor_provenance: Record fit/linearization context in the representation payload. Context-dependent approximation does not acquire ownership of those context observations or justify dropping supported tails.

FeedbackMessage.owns: Exactly one root prior and contiguous retired prefix[0,b)
fields: history error certificate or explicit unresolved status
FeedbackMessage.active_query: Combine M_b with the active window[b,n) once; normalize/marginalize with declared semantics. Feedback is referenced, never appended as an observation token.
FeedbackMessage.normalization: Retain normalizers for evidence comparisons and parameter-dependent terms. Preserve singular/deterministic measures without invented process noise. Solver GN is not posterior covariance.

CommitReceipt.meaning: Retirement committed; only now may producer discard the raw prefix

composition.rule: M_b proportional to integral K_[a,b)(s_b,eta|s_a) M_a(s_a,eta) ds_a; retain sharedeta rather than independently integrating it in each token
composition.semantics: Marginal probability measure. Profiling/minimization is a distinct interface and must not be silently substituted.
composition.order: Adjacent nonoverlapping intervals, matching entry/exit epochs and immutable source/model/chart/calibration/noise/evolution bindings
composition.quiet: Identity health transport adds no forced health change. Rest observations can legitimately update correlated parameters; unexcited independent directions retain uncertainty.
composition.error: Backend must retain accumulated approximation/arithmetic/model uncertainty or unresolved status. A digest is provenance, not an error bound.0.5%Q/0.5SOCpp are application assessment scales, not universal token admission tolerances.

lifecycle: Initialize one public prior at boundary0 with source/binding and root_prior_id
Receive every indexedVIT frame in active window; preserve actualdt and gaps
Read immutable feedback snapshot; fit active window with it once
EmitEstimateView for reporting, separately construct prior-free retirement token for oldest prefix

Prepare: compare base feedback identity, source/binding, contiguous interval, observed-end watermark, payload/domain/representation and configured byte capacity; build candidate without changing authoritative history
Commit: atomically publish candidate and receipt; identical immediately repeated commit returns same receipt without another update
Acknowledge: producer advances retired watermark and excludes retired raw frames from queries, then releases their storage
If acknowledgment is lost, reconcile receipt before any query; never combine new feedback with old active prefix
Abort/failure leaves old feedback and producer-owned raw data intact; overflow becomes explicit backpressure/unavailable status, never silent eviction
durability: Externally serialized in-process protocol. One pending candidate and last receipt suffice; no unbounded receipt log. SRAM-only baseline does not promise power-loss durability. Soft restore needs coordinated history/window/prior snapshots; a hard reset starts an explicit new generation without plant truth.

storage_estimates.scope: Illustrative float64 Gaussian numeric payloads for16boundary coordinates, not nonlinear battery representation or completeSRAM

implementation_scope: protocol.py implements metadata/transaction ownership with a supplied opaque backend. Numerical Gaussian backend lives only in qualification. No plant/load/ADC/model imports in protocol; no C rolling adapter or physical compressor is implemented by this contract.
next_gate: Implement producer/export and feedback query adapter around a small stationary continuous-parameter linearOCV Foster control, against independent retained-data reference. Check prior/source-once ownership and joint uncertainty before aging trajectories or storage optimization.
